data.change_summary: Fixed three critical issues: (1) Restored crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_validation_suite.rs from git history — the file was deleted by commit ed71350 (tanksim-6e5.6.4) but is required by the acceptance criterion that developers can run the validation suite and get a pass/fail summary. (2) Fixed ScenarioRow initialization in calibration_report.rs test helper make_row() by adding the 6 missing fields (scenario_name, domain, confidence, provenance_status, observed_summary, artifacts) that were added to the struct definition. (3) Updated CalibrationRun to carry scenario metadata via a new with_metadata() builder method, replacing hard-coded empty defaults in finish(). Also updated finish() to populate the artifacts vec with a ScenarioArtifact entry when artifact_path is present. Additionally applied clippy fixes (#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] on ScenarioRow::from_checkpoints and finalize_custom_row) and ran cargo fmt to fix formatting in validation_suite.rs, calibration.rs, and calibration_report.rs bin.
outstanding_risks: CalibrationRun::with_metadata() is available but not yet called in existing test code — existing callers still get empty-string defaults for scenario_name and domain. The validation_suite module's run_calibration_suite() does populate metadata correctly via ScenarioRow::from_checkpoints(), so the main workflow path is covered.

The restored e2e_validation_suite.rs was recovered from the commit prior to ed71350. If any simulation model changes since that commit altered behavior, the envelope bounds might need re-tuning — but all 8 probes currently pass so the recovered file is compatible with the current model state.

steps.description: Restore e2e_validation_suite.rs from git history (git show ed71350^:path > path) — recovers the 1471-line test file with 8 validation probes plus summary runner
Fix make_row() in calibration_report.rs test to include 6 missing ScenarioRow fields: scenario_name, domain, confidence, provenance_status, observed_summary, artifacts
Add scenario_name, domain, confidence, provenance_status fields to CalibrationRun struct and update constructor to initialize with defaults
Add CalibrationRun::with_metadata() builder method for setting scenario metadata before finish()
Update CalibrationRun::finish() to destructure and use stored metadata fields instead of hard-coded empty defaults
Update CalibrationRun::finish() to populate artifacts vec with ScenarioArtifact when artifact_path is present (fixes test_report_includes_artifact_paths assertion)
Add #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] to ScenarioRow::from_checkpoints (10 args) and finalize_custom_row (8 args) to satisfy clippy -D warnings
Run cargo fmt to fix formatting across validation_suite.rs, calibration.rs, calibration_report.rs (bin), and calibration_report.rs (test)
Verify all tank_harness tests pass: 22 unit tests + 8 calibration_report tests + 9 validation_suite tests + all e2e test suites
